lines: Welcome back. Members can now sign in, and sign out, on any device.
Enter your email and password, and you land on Home, greeted by name. While it works, the button says, signing in.
A wrong password, or an email we don't know, gets one message: email or password is incorrect. It never says which.
If the server fails, a message says so, and what you typed stays, ready to try again.
Signed in, the header offers Sign out, a full-size target on phone and desktop. It ends the session on the server itself.
Open a member page without a session, and you are taken to sign in.
Every change carries an antiforgery token, so another site cannot act for you, and every answer carries strict security headers.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Next, slice three point two: sign-in protections.
